name: Conscience
overview: Scripture reveals the conscience as an inner awareness of right and wrong, as seen when Adam and Eve recognized their nakedness and hid from God after sinning, indicating a new moral sensitivity (Genesis 3:7-8). The conscience also functions in human interactions, as illustrated by Pharaoh and Abimelech, who expressed concern and acknowledged the truth about Abraham's and Isaac's wives, respectively, showing an external manifestation of moral awareness (Genesis 12:18-19; 26:9). Additionally, Jacob’s honest accounting of property losses demonstrates a conscience attentive to integrity and responsibility (Genesis 31:39). These passages collectively highlight the conscience as both a God-given moral compass and a practical guide in daily life.
